# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.2.8 for Windows

- Includes USB library files in support reports by default to help the team investigate drive and library problems. Music and stems are not included.
- Lets you exclude library files, with clear guidance that keeping them included is strongly recommended for drive or library issues.
- Improves diagnostic details for library loading failures.
- Improves collection of Windows hardware and USB diagnostics.
